 INTRODUCTION 
 This module provides a default value for existing entities upon load.

 Back to top 

 INSTALLATION 
 The installation of this module is similar to other Drupal modules.

 
 Copy/upload the default_value module to the modules directory. 
 Enable the 'default_value' module and desired sub-modules in 'Extend'.

 ( /admin/modules )
 
 
 Back to top 

 CONFIGURATION 
 
 Configure your default value supported entities on the configuration page below: 
 Go to the default value settings page.

 Note: Admin -> Configuration -> System -> Default Value Settings
